components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default AntD primary action for login, save, verify, filter confirmation, and status submit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1677ff; color: #fdfefe; border: 1px solid #1677ff; border-radius: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 4px 15px; font: 400 14px/1.5715 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4096ff; border-color: #4096ff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #e6f4ff; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #0958d9; border-color: #0958d9; }

components.name: Operational Card
components.description: Flat AntD content surface for dashboard KPIs, settings panels, forms, and reports.
components.html:
Perlu Tindakan

Pesanan dibayar yang belum selesai.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fdfefe; color: #11181c; border: 1px solid #d9d9d9; border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: none; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #595959; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5715; }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: Text-first semantic status marker for order, payment, shipping, customer, and banner states.
components.css: .ds-tag-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 22px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 4px; background: #e6f4ff; color: #0958d9; border: 1px solid #91caff; font: 400 12px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard AntD form field for admin data entry, labels come from Form.Item.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #11181c; font: 400 14px/1.5715 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-input { height: 32px; padding: 4px 11px; border: 1px solid #d9d9d9; border-radius: 6px; background: #fdfefe; color: #11181c; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #4096ff; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #1677ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #e6f4ff; }

components.name: Notification Row
components.description: Unread admin order notification with pale blue fill, leading queue marker, and accessible button behavior.
components.css: .ds-notification-row { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-left: 3px solid #1677ff; background: #e6f4ff; color: #11181c; cursor: pointer; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-notification-row strong { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5715; font-weight: 600; } .ds-notification-row span { color: #595959; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-notification-row:hover, .ds-notification-row:focus-visible { outline: none; background: #f0f7ff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #91caff; }

components.name: Map Frame
components.description: Settings location picker frame with subtle border, rounded map viewport, and fallback-friendly container.
components.css: .ds-map-frame { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 100%; height: 300px; border: 1px solid #d9d9d9; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: #fafafa; color: #595959; font: 400 14px/1.5715 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: This system is a restrained Ant Design v5 and Refine Blue admin interface for pharmacy commerce work. It should feel like a dependable desk where paid orders, shipment exceptions, stock risks, and customer actions are easy to read without visual drama. Familiar controls are intentional: admins should recognize tables, forms, status tags, cards, and side navigation immediately.
keyCharacteristics: Refine resource shell with a 64px sticky header, responsive sidebar, and predictable CRUD routes.
Restrained blue primary palette with semantic AntD status colors.
Dense but legible tables, cards, forms, and status tags for daily admin work.
Indonesian-first copy, IDR formatting, and WCAG AA contrast intent.
Minimal custom motion; state feedback comes from AntD loading, focus, hover, drawers, modals, and skeletons.

rules.name: The Ten Percent Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is for action, current location, unread state, or selected state. If it appears as decoration, remove it.

rules.name: The Label-Before-Color Rule
rules.body: Every semantic color must travel with readable text. Tags may be orange, green, red, gold, cyan, purple, or volcano, but the status label is the meaning.

rules.name: The Native Trust Rule
rules.body: Use the system sans stack for all admin UI. Do not introduce display fonts into labels, buttons, tables, or data.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Temporary Rule
rules.body: Cards are flat at rest. Shadows belong to dropdowns, drawers, modals, and focus feedback, not dashboard decoration.

dos: Do use Refine resource conventions and AntD components as the default vocabulary for CRUD screens.
Do reserve Refine Operations Blue for primary actions, current state, selected state, focus, and unread queue emphasis.
Do keep status tags text-first and color-second, especially for payment, shipping, stock, customer ban, and banner activation states.
Do preserve Indonesian-first copy, IDR formatting, localized dates, postal-code constraints, and Biteship/Midtrans terminology.
donts: Don't create generic SaaS dashboards with interchangeable metric cards, decorative charts, vague blue branding, and no operational priority.
Don't make admin screens feel like a consumer shopping app with storefront polish, promotional browsing, or campaign-first layout.
Don't turn home banners into a flashy CMS or campaign builder. Keep media constrained, previewable, and safe.
Don't hide risk behind color alone, vague labels, or optimistic actions for payment, shipping, stock, customer bans, or published content.
